entries: Fixed read-only git commands in Bash unexpectedly asking for permission after a session had been running for a while (regression in 2.1.269)

title.zh-TW: 工作階段運行已久時，唯讀 Git 指令不再誤跳授權詢問
title.en: Read-only Git commands no longer mistakenly prompt for permission during long-running sessions

body.zh-TW: 當你長時間開啟工作階段（從開啟工具到結束對話的完整操作過程）處理專案時，如果只想查閱檔案紀錄，最怕流程莫名被打斷。⟦這好比在賣場貨架前翻看商品背面的成分說明，你既沒有拆封也沒有推走貨品，店員卻在你逛了一陣子後，每拿一瓶就突然上前要求你出示證件簽名。⟧在先前的 2.1.269 版本中，工具就出現了這項令人困擾的退步問題。當時只要你在 Bash（在黑底白字視窗裡輸入文字指令的運作環境）中持續操作了一段時間，原本完全不更動任何檔案的 Git 唯讀指令，就會出乎意料地彈出確認提示，反覆向你要求授權。特別是像 Git 這種用來追蹤檔案修改歷程的工具，其查詢狀態或檢視歷史的指令純粹只是讀取資料，本就不該頻繁索取權限。這項問題現在已經修好，往後即使工作階段持續運行，各類唯讀指令也能順暢完成，不再出現多餘的授權詢問來打斷你的思路。
body.en: When you keep a session open for a long time to work on a project and simply want to inspect file history, having your workflow randomly interrupted is frustrating. ⟦It is like browsing store shelves to check the ingredient labels on the back of products—without opening any packaging or taking items away, yet after you have shopped for a while, a clerk suddenly walks up and demands your ID and signature every single time you pick up a bottle.⟧ In the previous 2.1.269 release, the tool suffered from this frustrating regression. Back then, after operating for a while in Bash, read-only Git commands that modify no files at all would unexpectedly trigger confirmation prompts and repeatedly demand permission. Especially for a tool like Git used to track file modification history, commands that inspect status or view history purely read data and should never demand permissions so frequently. This issue has now been resolved; going forward, even when a session runs continuously, various read-only commands complete smoothly without unnecessary permission prompts interrupting your flow.

items.original: Fixed read-only git commands in Bash unexpectedly asking for permission after a session had been running for a while (regression in 2.1.269)

entries: GPT-6-Astra is now available in the model picker and Amazon Bedrock catalogs. (#42879, #42619)

Answer questions inline while Codex continues working, using suggested choices or custom text without losing your main draft. (#42891, #42894, #42897)
Windows sessions can now share a background Codex server, with daemon lifecycle commands and managed updates. (#42405, #42392)
Vim editing gains `R` replace mode with undo and dot-repeat, plus more reliable Escape handling in legacy terminals. (#42194, #42584)
Copying responses preserves formatting in rich-text apps, and `/copy` can copy status output or individual session fields. (#42847, #43055)
Existing sessions pick up newly installed plugin tools and refresh skills and hooks after external plugin upgrades or rollbacks. (#42284, #42593, #42990)
MCP connections coordinate OAuth token refreshes and surface login challenges when refresh fails, without automatically replaying rejected tool calls. (#42413, #42552)
Startup avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before trust is established, and the macOS sandbox blocks terminal input injection. (#42324, #42590)
Remote resume and fork operations preserve saved permissions; fresh sessions and forks respect server model defaults unless explicitly overridden. (#43330, #43177, #43355)
Resuming a conversation open in another app now shows a read-only transcript with a retry option while preserving your draft. (#43253)
Automatic approval reviews better preserve authorization context through compaction and reject approvals invalidated by new user instructions or answers. (#42844, #42852, #43442)
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs skill with GPT-6-Astra migration, compatibility, and prompting guidance. (#42931)
The deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is no longer available. (#42993)

title.zh-TW: GPT-6-Astra 上架模型挑選器與 Bedrock，官方文件同步補上轉移指引
title.en: GPT-6-Astra Arrives in Model Picker and Bedrock with Updated Migration Guides

body.zh-TW: 開發時想嘗試最新一代模型？現在進入模型挑選器（model picker，供切換不同 AI 版本的選單）即可直接選用 GPT-6-Astra。這項更新也同步推送到 Amazon Bedrock 的服務目錄中。若你正打算將既有專案遷移過來，內建的 OpenAI Docs 技能也已全面更新，針對 GPT-6-Astra 提供專門的轉移步驟、相容性說明與提示詞撰寫指引。⟦這就像車商正式將新旗艦車款陳列在展示中心與特約經銷商的型錄上，同時隨車手冊也立即換上新版的升級指南、相容說明與駕駛操作技巧。⟧無論你透過本機選單還是雲端目錄調用，都能直接對照指引順利切換。
body.en: Looking to try the latest model during development? You can now select GPT-6-Astra directly from the model picker. This update is also available in the Amazon Bedrock service catalog. If you plan to migrate existing projects, the bundled OpenAI Docs skill has been updated with dedicated migration steps, compatibility notes, and prompting guidance for GPT-6-Astra. ⟦It is like a carmaker showcasing a new flagship model in showrooms and dealership catalogs, while immediately updating the owner's manual with upgrade guides, compatibility details, and driving tips.⟧ Whether you invoke it from the local menu or cloud catalog, you can switch smoothly by following the guides.

items.original:
GPT-6-Astra is now available in the model picker and Amazon Bedrock catalogs. (#42879, #42619)
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs skill with GPT-6-Astra migration, compatibility, and prompting guidance. (#42931)

title.zh-TW: 實驗性工作樹支援登場，獨立簽出目錄支援瀏覽與續接
title.en: Experimental Worktree Support Arrives to Browse and Resume Isolated Checkouts

body.zh-TW: 你想同時處理多條開發分支又不想弄亂現有目錄？Codex 新增了實驗性的工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）支援。⟦這恰似圖書館為大型研究計畫增設獨立自修室，研究員可以帶著資料副本到專用房間閉門作業，中途可以走出房間瀏覽各室進度，稍後也能重新進房接續未完的研究，完全不會佔用大廳的公共閱覽桌。⟧現在只要在啟動時加上 `--worktree` 旗標，或在對話中輸入 `/worktree` 指令，就能為全新或分支衍生出的工作階段建立彼此隔離的簽出目錄。建立之後，你還能隨心瀏覽所有存在的工作樹，並重新續接先前的工作進度。
body.en: Want to work on multiple branches simultaneously without cluttering your current directory? Codex now introduces experimental worktree support. ⟦This is like a library setting up private study rooms for major research projects, allowing researchers to work behind closed doors with copies of materials, step out to browse progress across rooms, and return later to resume unfinished work without occupying shared reading tables.⟧ Simply pass the `--worktree` flag at startup or enter the `/worktree` command in a conversation to create isolated checkout directories for new or forked sessions. Once created, you can browse all existing worktrees and resume earlier progress at any time.

items.original: Experimental worktree support lets you create isolated checkouts for new or forked sessions using `--worktree` or `/worktree`, then browse and resume them. (#42652, #43069, #43120, #43286)

title.zh-TW: 背景執行中直接行內回答提問，提供建議選項且不丟失草稿
title.en: Answer Questions Inline While Working in Background Without Losing Drafts

body.zh-TW: 請 Codex 寫程式的同時，你不再需要被動等待它停下才能互動。當它在背景持續運作並向你提出疑問時，現在能直接在行內（inline，直接在當前內容中插入顯示）彈出提問並即時作答。⟦宛如主廚在料理台上全神貫注烹調主菜時，助手從旁遞上調味選擇的便條，主廚能順手打勾或寫上備註，手中的主菜鍋鏟完全不需停下。⟧你可以直接點選介面給出的建議選項，也能自行輸入自訂文字回答。更重要的是，這項互動完全不會清空或影響你原本在輸入框中打到一半的主草稿，確保思緒與進度雙軌推進。
body.en: You no longer have to wait idly for Codex to stop before interacting while it writes code. When Codex runs in the background and asks a question, it can now surface prompt questions inline for immediate replies. ⟦Just like an assistant handing seasoning option slips to a chef focused on cooking a main dish, allowing the chef to check boxes or jot notes without ever putting down the spatula.⟧ You can click suggested options provided by the interface or type custom text responses. Best of all, this interaction will not clear or affect your ongoing main draft in the input box, keeping both your thoughts and progress on track.

items.original: Answer questions inline while Codex continues working, using suggested choices or custom text without losing your main draft. (#42891, #42894, #42897)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援共享背景伺服器，提供守護行程管理指令與自動更新
title.en: Windows Adds Shared Background Server with Daemon Lifecycle Commands and Managed Updates

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境上使用 Codex，多個工作階段現在能共用同一個背景運行的伺服器，不必每個終端機視窗各自啟動一份。這次更新同步引入了守護行程（daemon，在背景持續默默提供服務的常駐程式）生命週期管理指令，讓你能查詢狀態、啟動或終止背景伺服器，同時還納入了託管更新機制，確保背景服務能平順接收後續升級。⟦這好比集合式辦公大樓設置中央公用影印列印中心，各樓層辦公室共用同一組背景運轉的專業主機與管理工具，不必每張桌子都各自擺一台高耗能印表機。⟧
body.en: Multiple sessions on Windows can now share a single background server instead of each terminal window starting its own. This update also introduces daemon lifecycle management commands to check status, start, or stop the background server, alongside managed updates to ensure background services receive future upgrades smoothly. ⟦This is like an office building setting up a central printing center where offices on each floor share the same background professional equipment and management tools, rather than placing power-hungry printers on every desk.⟧

items.original: Windows sessions can now share a background Codex server, with daemon lifecycle commands and managed updates. (#42405, #42392)

title.zh-TW: Vim 編輯新增 R 取代模式，支援復原與重複操作並改善退出鍵
title.en: Vim Editing Adds R Replace Mode with Undo, Dot-Repeat, and Reliable Escape Handling

body.zh-TW: 習慣 Vim 鍵盤操作的開發者，在編輯草稿時手感將更加俐落。這次更新為 Vim 模式補上了經典的 `R` 取代模式，讓你可以直接覆蓋游標處的字元。進行文字替換時，你能按鍵復原（undo，回復到修改前的文字），也能利用小數點鍵重複執行上一次的取代動作。針對舊型終端機，更新也改善了 Escape 鍵的訊號處理，讓跳離編輯模式的操作更可靠，避免按鍵延遲或失靈。⟦此舉有如手寫打字機具備了即時覆蓋色帶，既能直接壓字修正錯別字，又能藉由倒退鍵復原上一步或連打重複印字，同時也把老舊按鍵卡榫徹底潤滑修好。⟧
body.en: Developers accustomed to Vim keybindings will enjoy a snappier draft editing experience. This update brings the classic `R` replace mode to Vim mode, allowing you to overwrite characters directly under the cursor. During text replacement, you can undo changes and use the dot key to repeat your previous replacement action. For legacy terminals, the update improves Escape key handling, making exiting edit modes more reliable and avoiding key delays or failures. ⟦This is like a typewriter equipped with an instant correction ribbon that overwrites typos, allows backspacing to undo or repeating keystrokes, while fully lubricating worn-out mechanical key joints.⟧

items.original: Vim editing gains `R` replace mode with undo and dot-repeat, plus more reliable Escape handling in legacy terminals. (#42194, #42584)

title.zh-TW: 複製回覆保留富文字格式，/copy 指令支援狀態與欄位擷取
title.en: Copying Responses Preserves Rich-Text Formatting as /copy Gains Status and Field Extraction

body.zh-TW: 將對話產生的程式碼或說明貼到其他文書軟體時，排版不再被打亂成純文字了。現在從 Codex 複製回覆內容，貼入支援富文字（rich-text，包含粗體、標題與程式碼區塊等排版樣式）的應用程式時，會完整保留原本的格式外觀。與此同時，命令列工具的 `/copy` 指令也迎來功能強化，除了複製回覆本身，現在還能單獨複製狀態輸出，或是擷取工作階段內的特定個別欄位。⟦一如專業相機輸出照片，既能直接沖洗出帶有完整色彩與層次細節的精緻相片，也可以單獨將相機當前的拍攝數據或特定參數獨立匯出備查。⟧這讓整理文件與分享除錯資訊變得更順暢。
body.en: Pasting generated code or explanations into other document apps will no longer scramble formatting into plain text. Copying responses from Codex into rich-text applications now fully preserves the original styling and appearance. Meanwhile, the command-line `/copy` command has been enhanced to copy status output or extract specific individual fields from a session in addition to the response itself. ⟦Just like a professional camera outputting photos, which can develop fine prints with full color and tonal detail, or independently export current shooting metadata and specific parameters for reference.⟧ This makes organizing documentation and sharing debugging information much smoother.

items.original: Copying responses preserves formatting in rich-text apps, and `/copy` can copy status output or individual session fields. (#42847, #43055)

title.zh-TW: 現有工作階段動態辨識外掛工具，升級回捲自動重新整理
title.en: Existing Sessions Dynamically Detect Plugin Tools and Refresh on Upgrades or Rollbacks

body.zh-TW: 當你手邊的工作階段正在進行，外部外掛有了變更也不需要關掉重開。⟦這如同工廠的工具旋轉吊架，在技師開工期間若由後勤人員掛上新零件或替換工具規格，技師不必停工重開電閘，轉身就能直接拿取最新到貨的工具與操作手冊。⟧既有的工作階段現在具備動態感知能力，能在不中斷執行的情況下，即刻辨識剛安裝好的外掛工具。當外掛在外部完成升級或執行版本回捲時，當前視窗會立即重新整理相應的技能。連同內部定義的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）也會一併更新，確保所有自動化流程即時生效。
body.en: When your current session is running, you no longer need to restart it when external plugins change. ⟦This is like a factory rotating tool rack where logistics staff hang new parts or replace tool specifications while technicians work, allowing technicians to grab newly arrived tools and manuals without shutting down power or halting work.⟧ Existing sessions now feature dynamic detection to recognize newly installed plugin tools without interrupting execution. When plugins are upgraded or rolled back externally, the active window immediately refreshes corresponding skills. Internally defined hooks are updated as well, ensuring all automated workflows take effect immediately.

items.original: Existing sessions pick up newly installed plugin tools and refresh skills and hooks after external plugin upgrades or rollbacks. (#42284, #42593, #42990)

title.zh-TW: MCP 連線協調權杖更新與登入挑戰，舊版伺服器啟動入口退場
title.en: MCP Connections Coordinate Token Refreshes and Login Challenges as Legacy Entry Point Retires

body.zh-TW: 透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）串接外部服務時，授權憑證的維護現在更安全且井然有序。當多個工具連線需要更新 OAuth 授權權杖（token，用來驗證身分的授權令牌）時，Codex 會統一協調這些連線的更新動作。若更新失敗，介面會主動跳出登入驗證挑戰提示，絕不自動重播先前已被拒絕的工具呼叫。此外，先前已被標記為棄用的 `codex mcp-server` 啟動入口也在本次更新中正式移除。⟦猶如園區更新外包廠商的門禁機制，廠商證件過期時由系統集中協調換證，換證失敗即引導人員臨櫃重新認證，絕不拿遭拒的舊卡重複硬刷閘門；同時管理處也正式封閉已張貼告示的舊側門。⟧
body.en: Maintaining authorization credentials when connecting to external services via MCP is now safer and more orderly. When multiple tool connections require OAuth token refreshes, Codex coordinates the refresh across those connections. If a refresh fails, the interface surfaces login challenges without automatically replaying previously rejected tool calls. In addition, the previously deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is officially removed in this release. ⟦This is like an office park updating contractor access control, where expired badges are renewed through centralized coordination, failed renewals direct personnel to service counters for re-verification without repeatedly swiping rejected cards at gates, and management seals off the deprecated side entrance.⟧

items.original:
MCP connections coordinate OAuth token refreshes and surface login challenges when refresh fails, without automatically replaying rejected tool calls. (#42413, #42552)
The deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is no longer available. (#42993)

title.zh-TW: 啟動流程阻擋未信任輔助程式，macOS 沙盒嚴防終端機注入
title.en: Startup Blocks Untrusted Workspace Helpers as macOS Sandbox Prevents Terminal Injection

body.zh-TW: 開啟陌生專案目錄或在蘋果電腦上執行終端機，資安防線在開工當下就已全面就位。現在 Codex 在啟動過程中，若尚未與當前工作區建立明確的信任關係，會主動避免執行任何由工作區控制的輔助程式，杜絕惡意腳本趁虛而入。與此同時，macOS 系統下的沙盒（sandbox，隔離程式執行權限的保護層）也經過強化，能確實阻擋未經許可的終端機輸入注入攻擊。⟦這好似進入高度管制的實驗室，外部帶來的隨身器材在通過信任檢驗前一律禁止插電啟動，而隔離艙門的防護隔板也能阻擋外界未授權的按鈕信號干擾。⟧這讓你在檢視未知程式碼時能受到更周密的保護。
body.en: When opening unfamiliar project directories or running terminals on Mac computers, security defenses are active right from the start. During startup, Codex actively avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before establishing trust with the current workspace, preventing malicious scripts from taking advantage. Meanwhile, the macOS sandbox has been strengthened to block unauthorized terminal input injection attacks. ⟦This is like entering a high-security laboratory where personal equipment brought from outside cannot be powered on before trust verification, while containment barriers block unauthorized external button signals.⟧ This ensures thorough protection when inspecting unknown code.

items.original: Startup avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before trust is established, and the macOS sandbox blocks terminal input injection. (#42324, #42590)

title.zh-TW: 遠端續接與分支保留已存權限，新工作階段尊重預設模型
title.en: Remote Resume and Fork Preserve Saved Permissions While Fresh Sessions Follow Default Models

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端環境接續或分流既有進度時，設定與權限將維持一致。當你針對遠端工作階段執行續接（resume，接續先前中斷的進度）或分支操作時，先前已經儲存的授權與權限設定現在會完整延續，省去反覆確認授權的打擾。同時，全新開啟的工作階段以及衍生的分支，除非你在指令中明確指定其他模型，否則一律會嚴格遵守伺服器端配置的預設模型規格。⟦正如跨國企業指派主管遠端接管或分流專案小組，原有的門禁通行權限會自動跟隨繼承，而新立案的分支部門也會直接套用總部規範的標準設備，不必每次連線都重新簽呈。⟧此舉確保了跨端協同作業的權限延續性與環境規範。
body.en: Configurations and permissions remain consistent when resuming or branching progress in remote environments. When performing resume or fork operations on remote sessions, previously saved authorizations and permission settings are preserved, eliminating repetitive authorization prompts. Furthermore, fresh sessions and derived forks strictly respect server-configured default models unless you explicitly specify another model in your command. ⟦Just as a multinational enterprise assigns managers to take over or split project teams remotely, existing access permissions are automatically inherited, while newly chartered branch units adopt standard equipment prescribed by headquarters without requiring new approvals for each connection.⟧ This ensures permission continuity and environmental standards during remote collaboration.

items.original: Remote resume and fork operations preserve saved permissions; fresh sessions and forks respect server model defaults unless explicitly overridden. (#43330, #43177, #43355)

title.zh-TW: 跨應用程式續接對話防衝突，提供唯讀逐字紀錄且保留草稿
title.en: Cross-App Conversation Resume Prevents Conflicts with Read-Only Transcripts and Draft Preservation

body.zh-TW: 當你想接續處理某個對話，但該對話正巧在另一個應用程式中開啟時，現在不必再擔心進度衝突了。⟦彷彿走進銀行閱覽保管箱資料，若另一位共同持有者正在櫃檯查閱正本，行員會先為你提供唯讀對照副本與等候重試號碼牌，並妥善看管你正在填寫的申請表格。⟧Codex 會在介面上顯示唯讀的對話轉錄（transcript，完整對話逐字紀錄），讓你能回顧過往脈絡，並附上重新嘗試的按鈕選項。與此同時，你當前輸入框中正在撰寫的文字草稿也會受到完整保護，不會被清空或覆蓋，方便你在另一端釋放鎖定後立刻接手。
body.en: You no longer have to worry about progress conflicts when resuming a conversation that happens to be open in another application. ⟦It is like visiting a bank vault to inspect documents where, if a co-owner is reviewing the original at the counter, the clerk provides a read-only reference copy and a retry ticket while safeguarding the application form you are filling out.⟧ Codex displays a read-only transcript in the interface so you can review past context, accompanied by a retry button option. Meanwhile, your ongoing text draft in the input box remains protected without being cleared or overwritten, allowing you to take over immediately once the lock is released on the other side.

items.original: Resuming a conversation open in another app now shows a read-only transcript with a retry option while preserving your draft. (#43253)

title.zh-TW: 自動核准審查保留壓縮脈絡，遇新指令自動駁回失效授權
title.en: Automatic Approval Reviews Preserve Compaction Context and Reject Invalidated Authorizations

body.zh-TW: 面對需要反覆審核權限的操作流程，自動審查機制的判斷現在更加嚴謹周全。在對話歷程經歷壓縮（compaction，精簡長對話以節省記憶體的機制）後，自動核准審查機制能更完善地保留原本的授權脈絡，避免重要授權因紀錄濃縮而遺失。更重要的是，一旦使用者在後續給出了全新的指令或補充回答，只要先前的核准因此失效，審查機制就會果斷駁回該項核准，防止舊授權被錯誤套用到新情境。⟦類似於建築師審查工程變更單，即使過往會議紀錄經過摘要精簡，簽核依據依然完整留底；而只要業主中途變更了設計需求，先前簽核的舊工單就會立刻作廢重新評估。⟧
body.en: When dealing with workflows that require repeated permission reviews, automatic approval mechanisms are now more rigorous. Following conversation compaction, automatic approval reviews better preserve original authorization context, preventing critical authorizations from being lost due to history condensation. More importantly, once users provide fresh instructions or supplementary answers that invalidate earlier approvals, the review mechanism promptly rejects those approvals to prevent obsolete authorizations from being misapplied in new contexts. ⟦Similar to an architect reviewing engineering change orders, where approval records remain intact even after past meeting notes are summarized, but previously signed work orders are immediately invalidated for re-evaluation whenever the owner alters design requirements midway.⟧

items.original: Automatic approval reviews better preserve authorization context through compaction and reject approvals invalidated by new user instructions or answers. (#42844, #42852, #43442)

entries: Added the `/copy btw` slash subcommand to copy the full text of the active `/btw` side-question response to the clipboard even when the response card is collapsed or scrolled, along with argument ghost hints when typing `/copy`.
Improved tool-calling fidelity by translating per-request tool-choice constraints (`any`, `required`, and named functions) into native backend function-calling configurations.
Fixed the `/hooks` command and hook inspection utilities omitting hooks bundled inside enabled plugins when listing active `hooks.json` configurations.

Fixed custom subagents created with `enable_mcp_tools: true` receiving an empty MCP server list instead of inheriting the parent agent's configured MCP servers, and fixed declarative subagent configurations failing to resolve relative config file paths (`relative_path_to_config`) against the parent agent's directory.
Fixed proactive feedback prompts triggering prematurely during the first few turns of a session or on transient, recovered tool errors.

title.zh-TW: 新增 /copy btw 複製旁支回答全文，打指令附帶參數幽靈提示
title.en: Add /copy btw to copy full text of side-question responses, with argument ghost hints when typing commands

body.zh-TW: 一邊等待 AI 處理主要工作，一邊透過 `/btw` 提出旁支問題，取用解答文字現在更加俐落。⟦這好比在研討會聽講時，你在桌角備忘便條隨手記下專家的延伸解答；即使便條紙正巧被厚重講義遮住或摺疊收攏，專屬助理也能替你將整張便條的文字原樣複印到筆記夾中。⟧當你交代助理撰寫長篇企劃，趁空檔用 `/btw` 查詢專有名詞，讀完後想把整段答覆貼進工作報告，這正是輸入 `/copy btw` 的時刻。這項新增的斜線子指令，能將當前進行中的 `/btw` 旁支回答全文直接複製至剪貼簿，就算回覆卡片已經收合或被捲動移出可見畫面，也完全不影響複製。此外，當你在終端機鍵入 `/copy` 時，指令輸入列還會顯示參數的幽靈提示（輸入指令時以淡色顯示的待填參數建議），提醒你能接續輸入哪些可用選項。
body.en: While waiting for AI to handle primary tasks, asking side questions via `/btw` and retrieving the answer text is now much smoother. ⟦This is like attending a conference lecture and jotting down an expert's elaboration on a sticky note at the corner of your desk; even if the note happens to be covered by heavy handouts or folded away, your dedicated assistant can still copy the exact text from the entire note into your binder for you.⟧ When you ask an assistant to draft a long-form proposal and use `/btw` during downtime to look up technical terms, and then want to paste the full answer into your report after reading, this is the exact moment to type `/copy btw`. This newly added slash subcommand copies the full text of the active `/btw` side-question response directly to your clipboard, even if the response card is collapsed or scrolled out of view. In addition, when you type `/copy` in the terminal, the command input bar displays argument ghost hints (faded suggestions for parameters to fill in while typing commands) to remind you of available options you can enter next.

items.original: Added the `/copy btw` slash subcommand to copy the full text of the active `/btw` side-question response to the clipboard even when the response card is collapsed or scrolled, along with argument ghost hints when typing `/copy`.

title.zh-TW: 工具選用約束轉為原生後端設定，提升呼叫忠實度
title.en: Translate tool-choice constraints into native backend configurations to improve calling fidelity

body.zh-TW: 指揮 AI 配合特定流程呼叫工具時，模型遵循呼叫限制的表現現在更加精準可靠。以前在每次請求中指定工具選用約束，例如限制必須呼叫任意工具的 `any`、強制調用工具的 `required`，或是指定特定具名函式，若未深入底層，執行時偶爾仍可能偏離指示。現在系統會將每筆請求的工具選用約束，直接轉換為後端原生的函式呼叫設定（由模型服務底層介面直接控管工具挑選的機制），確保工具呼叫的保真度徹底落實。⟦恰似精密物流中心的分揀輸送帶，當包裹貼上「必須檢驗」或指定特定通道的標籤時，系統直接將分流指令寫入輸送帶底層的感應電路，包裹自然順著軌道精準送達，不再有任何錯漏。⟧
body.en: When directing AI to call tools for specific workflows, the model's adherence to calling restrictions is now more precise and reliable. Previously, when specifying per-request tool-choice constraints—such as `any` requiring calling any tool, `required` enforcing tool invocation, or specifying named functions—executions could still occasionally deviate from instructions if not integrated into the underlying layer. Now, the system directly translates per-request tool-choice constraints into native backend function-calling configurations (a mechanism where the model service's underlying interface directly manages tool selection), ensuring complete fidelity in tool calling. ⟦Just like a sorting conveyor belt in a precision logistics center, when a package is labeled 'must inspect' or assigned a specific lane, the system writes routing instructions directly into the conveyor's underlying sensor circuits, allowing packages to arrive precisely along the track without errors.⟧

items.original: Improved tool-calling fidelity by translating per-request tool-choice constraints (`any`, `required`, and named functions) into native backend function-calling configurations.

title.zh-TW: /hooks 與檢查工具納入已啟用外掛隨附的掛鉤設定
title.en: Include hook configurations bundled inside enabled plugins in /hooks and inspection utilities

body.zh-TW: 檢查自動化流程的掛鉤設定時，外掛隨附的規則不再無端隱形。以前在終端機執行 `/hooks` 指令或使用掛鉤檢查工具列出使用中的 `hooks.json` 設定時，系統會漏掉已啟用外掛套件裡自帶的 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），導致你難以確認外掛功能是否如期攔截；這個遺漏問題現在已經修好，清單會如實列出已啟用外掛隨附的所有掛鉤設定。
body.en: When inspecting hook configurations in automated workflows, rules bundled with plugins no longer invisibly disappear. Previously, when running the `/hooks` command in the terminal or using hook inspection utilities to list active `hooks.json` configurations, the system omitted hooks bundled inside enabled plugin packages (small programs triggered when specific events occur), making it difficult to verify whether plugin features were intercepting as expected. This omission issue is now fixed, and listings faithfully include all hook configurations bundled with enabled plugins.

items.original: Fixed the `/hooks` command and hook inspection utilities omitting hooks bundled inside enabled plugins when listing active `hooks.json` configurations.

title.zh-TW: 自訂子代理繼承父代理 MCP 伺服器，並正確解析相對設定路徑
title.en: Custom subagents inherit parent MCP servers and correctly resolve relative configuration paths

body.zh-TW: 配置專門分工的自訂子代理時，工具連線與檔案路徑的兩項問題已獲修正。以前在建立自訂子代理時就算指定了 `enable_mcp_tools: true`，子代理也只會收到一份空的伺服器清單，無法順利繼承父代理原先設定妥當的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器；同時，宣告式子代理設定若使用 `relative_path_to_config` 指定相對設定檔路徑，系統也無法以父代理所在的目錄為基準完成解析。這兩項路徑與設定繼承問題現在都已經修好，子代理會確實繼承父代理的外部工具伺服器，相對路徑也能順利對齊。
body.en: When configuring custom subagents for specialized division of labor, two issues with tool connections and file paths have been fixed. Previously, even if `enable_mcp_tools: true` was specified when creating a custom subagent, the subagent only received an empty server list and failed to inherit the configured MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol allowing AI to connect to external tools) servers from the parent agent. At the same time, if a declarative subagent configuration specified a relative configuration file path using `relative_path_to_config`, the system failed to resolve it against the parent agent's directory. Both path and configuration inheritance issues are now fixed, ensuring subagents properly inherit the parent agent's external tool servers and relative paths align smoothly.

items.original: Fixed custom subagents created with `enable_mcp_tools: true` receiving an empty MCP server list instead of inheriting the parent agent's configured MCP servers, and fixed declarative subagent configurations failing to resolve relative config file paths (`relative_path_to_config`) against the parent agent's directory.

title.zh-TW: 主動回饋提示不再過早跳出，排除初期對話與暫態錯誤干擾
title.en: Proactive feedback prompts no longer trigger prematurely, eliminating early-session and transient-error disruptions

body.zh-TW: 在終端機展開新對話或使用工具時，評分詢問不再無端跳出打擾節奏。以前只要工作階段剛開始的前幾輪對話、或者工具遇到短暫發生但隨後已順利復原的暫態錯誤，系統的主動回饋提示就會過早觸發，在任務尚未明朗時突然向你索取意見；這個過早觸發的問題現在已經修好，不會再在對話初期或暫態錯誤復原時過早彈出提示打斷思路。
body.en: When starting a new conversation in the terminal or using tools, feedback rating prompts no longer pop up unexpectedly to disrupt your flow. Previously, during the first few turns of a session or when tools encountered transient errors that quickly recovered, proactive feedback prompts triggered prematurely, soliciting feedback before tasks were clear. This premature triggering issue is now fixed, preventing pop-up prompts from interrupting your train of thought during early conversations or recovered transient errors.

items.original: Fixed proactive feedback prompts triggering prematurely during the first few turns of a session or on transient, recovered tool errors.

entries: **The weekly quota warning no longer fires from a short burst of use, and the time it shows now matches the reason it fired** ([#138](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/138)). It used to extrapolate only the last 30–60 minutes of burn rate onto the 7-day window, so a dense working session alone could trigger a false alarm (e.g. 53.7% used, 3 days 1 hour to reset, warned "runs out in 13 hours"). `assess_weekly_quota()` now checks both rates: the short window still warns immediately if it alone predicts exhaustion within an hour, but otherwise the whole-week average must predict exhaustion at least 20% of the reset window early (`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`) before it warns — and displays that average's time instead of the short window's, which previously could show a number like "runs out in 8h55m" next to a warning actually driven by a slower week-long trend, contradicting the separate 5-hour session quota shown beside it. Session-quota warnings are unchanged.

**The Windows tray panel could stay stuck at `--` and Loading forever when `~/.claude/settings.json` had a UTF-8 BOM.** `installer/setup_hook.py` opened the file as plain `utf-8`, and Python's JSON decoder rejects an otherwise-valid file that starts with a BOM with `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM`, so the startup self-heal step failed before the refresh loop ever completed. Both readers (`_load_settings()` and the legacy-usage migration) now open the file as `utf-8-sig`, which accepts the file with or without a BOM and does not change the parsed settings.

title.zh-TW: 週額度用完警示校準推算邏輯，短暫衝刺不再引發誤報
title.en: Weekly quota exhaustion warnings calibrate projection logic, preventing false alarms from brief usage bursts

body.zh-TW: 密集使用 AI 時，週額度用完警示不再因短時間衝刺就誤報。⟦這好比行車電腦預估剩餘續航，不能只因剛踩了幾秒重油門，就驚呼整桶油在半小時內見底。⟧過去只拿最近 30～60 分鐘的消耗速度外推整個 7 天週期，密集工作階段常引發假警報（例如本週用了 53.7%、還有 3 天 1 小時重置，卻警告「13 小時後用完」）。現在 `assess_weekly_quota()` 同時檢查兩種速度：短窗速度若預測 1 小時內用完仍會立刻示警；其餘情況須整週平均速度預測用完時間提前至少 20%（`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`）才警示。介面改為顯示整週平均預測的時間，不再出現「8h55m 後用完」卻與旁邊 5 小時工作階段額度矛盾的狀況；5 小時工作階段額度警示規則維持不變。
body.en: During intensive AI use, weekly quota exhaustion warnings no longer trigger false alarms from short bursts of activity. ⟦This is like a trip computer estimating remaining range—it shouldn't panic that the entire tank will run dry in half an hour just because you stepped on the gas for a few seconds.⟧ Previously, it extrapolated only the burn rate from the last 30–60 minutes across the entire 7-day cycle, so intensive sessions often triggered false alarms (such as using 53.7% this week with 3 days and 1 hour until reset, yet warning "runs out in 13 hours"). Now, `assess_weekly_quota()` checks both rates: if the short-window rate predicts exhaustion within 1 hour, it still warns immediately; otherwise, the whole-week average rate must predict exhaustion at least 20% early (`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`) before raising a warning. The interface now displays the time predicted by the whole-week average, eliminating confusing scenarios where "runs out in 8h55m" contradicted the adjacent 5-hour session quota; rules for 5-hour session quota warnings remain unchanged.

items.original: **The weekly quota warning no longer fires from a short burst of use, and the time it shows now matches the reason it fired** ([#138](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/138)). It used to extrapolate only the last 30–60 minutes of burn rate onto the 7-day window, so a dense working session alone could trigger a false alarm (e.g. 53.7% used, 3 days 1 hour to reset, warned "runs out in 13 hours"). `assess_weekly_quota()` now checks both rates: the short window still warns immediately if it alone predicts exhaustion within an hour, but otherwise the whole-week average must predict exhaustion at least 20% of the reset window early (`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`) before it warns — and displays that average's time instead of the short window's, which previously could show a number like "runs out in 8h55m" next to a warning actually driven by a slower week-long trend, contradicting the separate 5-hour session quota shown beside it. Session-quota warnings are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣支援 UTF-8 BOM 設定檔，徹底告別卡死與載入中
title.en: Windows system tray supports UTF-8 BOM config files, resolving freezes and endless loading

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 電腦上，當 Claude 設定檔 `~/.claude/settings.json` 帶有 UTF-8 BOM（位元組順序記號，部分編輯器在開頭加入的隱藏標記），系統匣面板不再卡在 `--` 與 Loading。過去 `installer/setup_hook.py` 用一般 `utf-8` 開啟檔案，Python 的解析器把開頭帶 BOM 的有效檔案判為 `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM` 錯誤，導致啟動自我修復步驟在刷新迴圈跑完前就失敗。現在 `_load_settings()` 與舊版遷移邏輯皆改用 `utf-8-sig`，不論檔案有無 BOM 都能正常讀取且設定內容不變。⟦這宛如收發窗口先前看到信件開頭多了一枚印章，就誤判整份合規公文無效而拒絕拆閱；換上相容的判讀方式後，運作才重回正軌。⟧
body.en: On Windows, when Claude's config file `~/.claude/settings.json` contains a UTF-8 BOM (byte order mark, a hidden marker added at the beginning by some editors), the system tray panel no longer gets stuck at `--` and Loading. Previously, `installer/setup_hook.py` opened the file as plain `utf-8`, causing Python's parser to reject valid files with a BOM with an `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM` error, so the startup self-heal step failed before the refresh loop could complete. Now, both `_load_settings()` and the legacy migration logic use `utf-8-sig`, reading the file properly whether a BOM is present or not without altering parsed settings. ⟦This is like a mailroom rejecting a valid official document simply because it has an extra stamp at the top; switching to a compatible reading method puts operations back on track.⟧

items.original: **The Windows tray panel could stay stuck at `--` and Loading forever when `~/.claude/settings.json` had a UTF-8 BOM.** `installer/setup_hook.py` opened the file as plain `utf-8`, and Python's JSON decoder rejects an otherwise-valid file that starts with a BOM with `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM`, so the startup self-heal step failed before the refresh loop ever completed. Both readers (`_load_settings()` and the legacy-usage migration) now open the file as `utf-8-sig`, which accepts the file with or without a BOM and does not change the parsed settings.

entries:
## Linux package repository signing key rotation

GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Linux users who installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not refreshed their keyring, may now see package installation or update failures. Follow the [PGP signing key rotation guidance](https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/13118) to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and users who installed `gh` through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

## Copy authentication codes to the clipboard by default

`gh auth login` and `gh auth refresh` now copy OAuth device codes to the clipboard by default, saving a manual copy step during authentication.

To persistently opt out, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options still take precedence for an individual invocation.

title.zh-TW: Linux 套件庫全面換用新金鑰，舊安裝需更新金鑰圈
title.en: Linux Package Repositories Switch to New Signing Key, Existing Installs Require Keyring Update

body.zh-TW: 你在 Linux 上更新或安裝 `gh` 若遇到驗證錯誤，可能是本機尚未登記新印鑑。⟦這好比社區大樓換了新門禁印章，住戶若沒登記新印記，警衛核對舊印鑑就會拒絕放行。⟧ GitHub CLI 的 APT 與 RPM 套件庫（Linux 下載與管理軟體的官方倉庫）與個別 RPM 包。它們現在僅以新的 PGP 金鑰（fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`）簽署。若你在 2026 年 4 月 8 日前透過官方 APT 或 RPM 套件庫安裝 `gh` 且尚未更新金鑰圈（存放信任憑證的鑰匙庫），安裝或升級可能失敗。請依照官方的 PGP 簽章金鑰輪換指引更新金鑰圈以排除問題。Windows 與 macOS 使用者，或透過 Homebrew、GitHub Releases、其他套件管理器及原始碼安裝者，則不受影響。
body.en: If you encounter verification errors when updating or installing `gh` on Linux, your system may not have registered the new stamp yet. ⟦This is like a residential community switching to a new access control stamp; if residents haven't registered the new mark, security checking the old stamp will deny entry.⟧ GitHub CLI's APT and RPM package repositories and individual RPM packages are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`). If you installed `gh` through the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not yet updated your keyring, package installation or upgrades may fail. Follow the official PGP signing key rotation guidance to update your keyring and resolve the issue. Users on Windows and macOS, or those who installed via Homebrew, GitHub Releases, other package managers, or from source, are not affected.

title.zh-TW: 登入驗證碼預設自動複製，省下繁瑣手動步驟
title.en: Authentication Codes Copied to Clipboard by Default, Saving Manual Steps

body.zh-TW:
登入 GitHub 帳號或刷新授權時，終端機現在會自動幫你保管驗證碼，省下一道手動複製手續。過去執行 `gh auth login` 登入或 `gh auth refresh` 刷新權限時，畫面會給出一組要在瀏覽器填寫的 OAuth 裝置代碼（在授權網頁輸入以確認本機身分的驗證碼）。以往得手動反白並複製，現在執行這兩項指令時，預設會主動將代碼複製進剪貼簿，切換視窗直接貼上即可。⟦這好比到櫃檯辦業務時，人員直接把號碼牌遞到你手裡，不必自己拿筆在旁邊抄號碼。⟧ 若想永久關閉此功能，可執行設定指令：

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

單次呼叫時若有明確指定剪貼簿選項，依然享有最高優先權。
body.en:
When signing in to your GitHub account or refreshing authorization, the terminal now automatically handles the verification code for you, saving a manual copy step. Previously, running `gh auth login` to sign in or `gh auth refresh` to refresh permissions displayed an OAuth device code to be entered in the browser. While you previously had to manually highlight and copy it, running these two commands now copies the code to the clipboard by default, allowing you to switch windows and paste directly. ⟦This is like visiting a service counter where the staff hands the queue slip directly to you, so you don't have to write the number down yourself with a pen.⟧ To permanently disable this feature, run the configuration command:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options specified for an individual invocation still take highest precedence.
